prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: game foliage alpha-cutout texture atlas, ONE square PNG with genuine transparent background.
Primary request: Create a 2 by 2 atlas of FOUR distinct painted OAK LEAF SPRIG clusters, for a real-time 3D forest town whose style is the supplied reference. This is a texture sheet, not a scene.
Input image: style reference only. Match its organized broad painterly pixel-like color patches and organic scalloped foliage silhouette.
Composition: four separate clusters, exactly centered in four equal quadrants of a square 2048 x 2048 image. Keep a generous transparent gutter along all outer edges and the center cross; no sprig crossing cell borders. Each quadrant contains one graceful asymmetrical small branching twig bearing 12–18 recognizable rounded five-lobed oak leaves, overlapping into a coherent leafy spray but with a few small transparent gaps. Variations: broad rounded spray, diagonal fan, compact bush spray, long hanging spray.
Color palette: strictly neutral GRAYSCALE, light gray leaf surfaces at roughly 70–90 percent brightness, darker medium gray twig and folds, suitable for multiplicative vertex-color tinting. No black outlines.
Materials/textures: carefully designed crisp lobed silhouettes, simple midrib, two or three broad paint-tone patches per leaf, only restrained veins. Plenty of readable leaf forms; denser toward center, irregular edges. Broad clustered shading, soft matte brush marks with occasional stepped pixel-like edges, no photoreal noise, no excessive tiny grains.
Lighting: flat diffuse albedo with mild painted volume, no cast shadow or directional baked lighting.
Constraints: transparent background with real alpha; absolutely no checkerboard painted into image, no white or gray rectangular backgrounds, no labels, no text, no border, no pots, no terrain, no tree trunk. Every leaf remains entirely inside its quadrant.
